description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewaySession component of the openclaw project, specifically testing WebSocket connection handling, token management, and node invoke request handling in an Android environment using Robolectric. It includes test cases for connection strategies, token storage, request/response serialization, and error handling.

classes.name: InMemoryDeviceAuthStore
classes.description: A simple in-memory implementation of DeviceAuthTokenStore for testing token storage behavior.

classes.name: NodeHarness
classes.description: A data class bundling a GatewaySession, its Job, and the DeviceAuthStore for testing.

classes.name: InvokeScenarioResult
classes.description: Contains the request and resulting parsed JSON object after running a node invoke scenario.

classes.name: GatewaySessionInvokeTest
classes.description: Test class annotated with RobolectricTestRunner for unit testing GatewaySession behaviors.

methods.name: testJson
methods.description: Creates a Json parser instance configured to ignore unknown keys.

methods.name: createNodeHarness
methods.description: Sets up a GatewaySession with a mock device auth store and connection handlers for testing.

methods.name: connectNodeSession
methods.description: Connects a GatewaySession to a specified endpoint with optional tokens for testing.

methods.name: awaitConnectedOrThrow
methods.description: Waits for the session to connect or throws if not connected within timeout.

methods.name: shutdownHarness
methods.description: Cleans up the test harness by disconnecting session, cancelling job, and shutting down server.

methods.name: runInvokeScenario
methods.description: Runs a test scenario for node.invoke.request and processes the WebSocket communication.

methods.name: connectResponseFrame
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for WebSocket responses containing connection info.

methods.name: startGatewayServer
methods.description: Creates a mock WebSocket server that responds to specific messages, used for testing.
